dumpster.description: My personal website hosted on Nekoweb. It will be my little corner of the internet where I'll store all kinds of projects I've made or am currently developing. What you're looking at right now is one of the biggest public projects I have!

gallery.1-0-0: A screenshot of the latest version, v1.X, before the massive refactoring in mithril.js. I always tried to go for a transparent design, but I could never get the balance right so that it would be transparent while still making the text legible. It’s the worst design the entire site has ever had. A refactoring was necessary.
gallery.2-0-0: The first version of the major refactoring, v2.X. The page has been completely overhauled as planned. It is no longer designed using separate HTML files for each section; everything is now contained in a single HTML file and a JS script. The script features a large number of routes and several virtual nodes, allowing the entire website to function as a Single-Page Application SPA. That’s why you can now navigate between pages without having to reload the entire page from scratch!
gallery.2-1-0: A small but decent QoL (Quality of Life) update for the website, an improved visual style, and a few minor fixes and missing elements carried over from the previous version compared to v1.X

gallery.gta: Want the heist with the most money of all? Cayo Perico. Want the most annoying heist? Cayo Perico. Want the heist with the most bugs in history? Cayo Perico. I hope GTA 6 doesn't have a Cayo Perico.
gallery.hl: One of the best series Valve has ever created, though sadly it has very little content. I'll be waiting for a third installment! :D
gallery.hytale: A lot of people say it's like Minecraft because it has certain aspects of Minecraft, but it's not quite Minecraft because it's missing some things from Minecraft, so it's a little more like Terraria because it has certain aspects of Terraria, but it's not quite Terraria because it's missing some things from Terraria-
gallery.isaac: There was absolutely no need to make a cover as intense as this one. The game? Same thing. There was absolutely no need to make it so epic.
gallery.minecraft: I'm genuinely hyped about Sift, I can't wait any longer. I NEED IT.
gallery.portal1: You spend 20 minutes staring at a puzzle trying to figure it out...
gallery.portal2: You spend 20 minutes staring at a puzzle trying to figure it out... This time with a friend!
gallery.roblox: It’s the only platform in history that has figured out how to create a game engine that’s both so portable and yet so highly programmable that it allows you to have millions of games in a single one just by requesting certain files. It’s the only platform that treats its users like shit. Not even like numbers on a graph. Worse than that.
gallery.scp: Ignoring the fact that the game is built on an absurdly old and niche engine filled with bugs and fatal crashes, it's the only game that genuinely makes me feel scared. Every new area has a chance of SCP-173 camping around a corner waiting to kill you.
gallery.terraria: I really love that it focuses more on combat than on the sandbox aspect itself, but without completely neglecting it. Unfortunately, though, starting a new world is horribly slow :(
gallery.tf: I've put in over a thousand hours into this game, and I'm still playing like crap. It's a complicated and toxic relationship.
gallery.votv: It's like sitting at your desk for an hour trying to get a signal, only for it to fail in the end and have to start all over again. I love this game, but sometimes it can take a while for an event to trigger, which can get boring or repetitive.
gallery.warframe: 100% recommended. One of the best games and the most F2P-friendly one I've ever played. Sadly, sometimes it goes way overboard with loot, so getting certain characters or advancing through the story can be a grueling grind to the point of burnout. I hope DE can improve some of the farming and tweak certain… mechanics, like having to wait 3 DAYS to craft a Warframe.
